title: Onboarding Guide
htmlBody:
Onboarding Guide

Welcome to the Acme SaaS onboarding process. Follow these steps to get your account set up.

Step 1: Create your account

Visit the sign-up page and fill in your details. You will receive a confirmation email.

Step 2: Invite your team

Go to Settings → Team to invite colleagues by email.

title: API Reference Overview
htmlBody:
API Reference Overview

The Acme SaaS REST API uses standard HTTP verbs. All responses are JSON.

Authentication

Pass your API key in the Authorization: Bearer <key> header.

Rate limits

Free tier: 100 requests/minute. Pro: 1000 requests/minute.

title: Troubleshooting Common Issues
htmlBody:
Troubleshooting Common Issues

Login problems

If you cannot log in, try clearing your browser cache or using an incognito window. If the issue persists, reset your password via Forgot Password.

Slow performance

Performance issues are often caused by browser extensions. Disable them one by one to identify the culprit.
